methodology: Each policy supports all twelve feature combinations; no mode-specific model selection.
Candidates are selected by equal-weight macro mean survival on eight shared development seeds per mode.
The original baseline is an eligible candidate; exact ties follow the fixed candidate order, baseline first.
Selected weights are frozen and development seeds added to validation lineage before held-out evaluation.
Test comparison uses the same twenty untouched seeds per mode and the identical engine binary.
The percentile bootstrap resamples the twenty shared seed clusters, retaining all twelve modes together.
Candidate budgets list the latest PPO phase plus inherited imitation budget; earlier baseline training is shared.
limitations: One training seed per configuration; there are no independent replicate training runs.
The confidence interval covers evaluation-seed variation only, not training randomness or adaptive search.
Development results were used adaptively to choose experiments and are not independent generalization evidence.
Imitation and teacher-guided PPO use extra teacher labels; they are not equal-data-budget pure-PPO comparisons.
Environment balance, optimizer stability changes and schedule changes are bundled; this is not a causal ablation.
Survival is capped at 300 pieces, and twenty test seeds per mode provide limited evidence for long-tail performance.
Policy actions select legal final placements; the experiment does not measure real-time keyboard control.
